title: QUIC Connectionmigration Source-Address Blocker Verification
verification_method: Requirement-home tests, setup-script inspection, local clean-runner artifact inspection, and hosted connectionmigration proof artifact inspection.
preconditions: The connectionmigration proof lane remains bounded to the dedicated hosted profile.
The preferred migration address setup remains present in the startup script.
The current-status, spec, and verification notes are present.
scope: Verify that the repository closes the bounded connectionmigration source-address proof while preserving the preferred-address setup and avoiding rebind, QUIC v2, HTTP/3, or broad support claims.
procedure: Review `docs/current-status.md` and `specs/requirements/quic/SPEC-QUIC-INT.json` to confirm the blocker lane is formalized.
Inspect `src/Incursa.Quic.InteropHarness/setup.sh` and `src/Incursa.Quic.InteropHarness/README.md` for the preferred-address setup.
Run the focused requirement-home tests for `REQ-QUIC-INT-0025` plus the supporting RFC9000 migration proofs `RFC9000-S9-6-1-P4-S2-R01`, `RFC9000-S9-6-2-P2-S3-R01`, and `RFC9000-S9-6-3-P5-S1-R01`.
Confirm the blocker note remains bounded and separate from rebind, QUIC v2, HTTP/3, or broad support claims.

Inspect local clean-runner proof `.artifacts/interop-runner/connectionmigration-shim-proof/20260519-163904754-server-nginx` for original-path first-flight source selection, preferred-address path observation, and `runner-report.json` success.

Inspect hosted run `26174181713` under `.artifacts/gh-run-26174181713/interop-runner-server-connectionmigration-neqo-26174181713/20260520-155738932-server-nginx` for `runner-report.json` success, completed transfer, original/preferred path observation, qlog-backed PATH_CHALLENGE/PATH_RESPONSE evidence, and active-migration DCID change.
expected_result: The repository can classify the connectionmigration source-address issue as locally and hosted-proven for the bounded `connectionmigration` profile while keeping `rebind-port`, `rebind-addr`, QUIC v2, HTTP/3, and broad support-readiness out of scope.
status_summary: Complete for local and hosted proof. Focused requirement-home tests passed for `REQ_QUIC_INT_0025`, `REQ_QUIC_INT_0022`, and `REQ_QUIC_INT_0018`, and local clean-runner proof `.artifacts/interop-runner/connectionmigration-shim-proof/20260519-163904754-server-nginx` passed `connectionmigration` against `neqo` with first server flight sourced from original address `fd00:cafe:cafe:100::100` before later preferred-address use from `fd00:cafe:cafe:100::110`. Hosted run `26174181713` passed at commit `9ee3266e`; `runner-report.json` records `connectionmigration` as `succeeded`, output records a completed 2 MiB response, qlog fallback confirms server PATH_CHALLENGE/client PATH_RESPONSE evidence on the migrated path, and the active-migration DCID changed to `20:21:22:23:24:25:26:27`. This remains bounded to connectionmigration.

supplemental_sections.heading: Scope
supplemental_sections.content: This verification covers local and hosted source-address proof for the bounded connectionmigration profile. It does not claim `rebind-port`, `rebind-addr`, QUIC v2, or HTTP/3 support.
